label: Launch pad: Apollo, LC-39
what: The Saturn V pad: the 380 ft Launch Umbilical Tower with swing arms that fall away at liftoff, and the flame trench. Sizes from NASA figures on Wikipedia.

label: Launch pad: Space Shuttle, LC-39
what: The Shuttle pad: the Fixed Service Structure (350 ft with its mast), the Rotating Service Structure swung back, the 290 ft water tower. Main heights from Wikipedia; the rest approximate.

label: Launch pad: SLS, LC-39B
what: The Artemis pad: the Mobile Launcher tower beside the rocket and three tall lightning towers. Sizes approximate.

label: Launch pad: Soyuz, Baikonur and Plesetsk
what: The R-7 family pad: four support arms that fall outward at liftoff, two retracted service cabins, lightning masts, the flame pit. Sizes approximate.

label: Launch pad: Proton, Baikonur
what: A fixed service tower with swing arms that retract at liftoff, beside the flame trench. Sizes approximate.

label: Launch pad: Falcon, LC-39A
what: SpaceX at 39A: the transporter-erector that leans back 1.5 degrees before liftoff and 45 at it, the old tower extended above 350 ft. Figures from Wikipedia.

label: Launch pad: Falcon, SLC-40 with crew tower
what: SpaceX at SLC-40 since the crew access tower of 2023, with the transporter-erector tilting away at liftoff. Tower height approximate.

label: Launch pad: Falcon, SLC-40 and SLC-4E
what: A bare Falcon pad: the transporter-erector tilting away at liftoff, and lightning masts. Sizes approximate.

label: Launch pad: Starship, Starbase
what: The Starbase launch tower with its catching arms held open. Tower height approximate.

label: Launch pad: Atlas V, SLC-41
what: The ULA pad: mobile launch platform, umbilical tower and four lightning towers; the Vertical Integration Facility stands off the pad and is left out. Sizes approximate.

label: Launch pad: Cape service-tower pad
what: The Cape's Atlas, Delta, Titan and Saturn IB pads: an umbilical tower with swing arms beside the vehicle. Sizes approximate.

label: Launch pad: Ariane 4 and 5, Kourou
what: The ELA-2 and ELA-3 pads: an umbilical mast beside the launcher and four tall lightning towers. Sizes approximate.

label: Launch pad: Ariane 6, Kourou
what: The ELA-4 pad: the umbilical mast, two lightning towers and the mobile gantry rolled well back. Sizes approximate.

label: Launch pad: Chinese service tower
what: The fixed service tower of Jiuquan, Xichang, Wenchang and Taiyuan, its working platforms folding away at liftoff. Sizes approximate.

label: Launch pad: Tanegashima
what: The Yoshinobu pad: the H-II launcher's umbilical tower and a lightning tower. Sizes approximate.

label: Launch pad: Sriharikota
what: The ISRO pad: the umbilical tower beside the vehicle and the mobile service tower rolled well back. Sizes approximate.
